build_conditional_tensor: build a LongTensor from object annotations with optional crop coordinates and horizontal flip using ObjectsCenterPointsConditionalBuilder
tokenize_coordinates: tokenize normalized 2D coordinates into a single discrete token value using the grid-based encoding scheme
inverse_build_conditional: decode a conditional LongTensor back into object representations with coordinates and optional crop bounding box
plot_conditional: plot a conditional tensor as a PIL image with colored circles and labels for each object representation
object_representation: encode an Annotation object into an integer representation using category number and optional group and additional parameters
